ayahOccurrences.text: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن نَّبِىٍّ قَٰتَلَ مَعَهُۥ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرٌ فَمَا وَهَنُوا۟ لِمَآ أَصَابَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ضَعُفُوا۟ وَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ فِى عَامَيْنِ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَهِنُوا۟ is in the derivative form: وَهَنَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/هـ/ن   w–h–n to be weak, to be feeble, to be infirm, to be languid, to be lethargic
; the last hours of the night.

Of this root, 4 forms occur 9 times in the Qur’an:
وَهَنَ wahana 5 times; وَهْنٌ wahn 2 times; أَوْهَنُ ʾawhan 1 time and مُوهِنٌ mūhin 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
وَهَنَ wahana i [v. intrans.]

1 to become feeble, to weaken

(19:4) إِنِّي وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي the bones within me have weakened

2 to tire, to become reticent, to become faint‐hearted

(4:104) وَلاَ تَهِنُوا فِى ابْتِغَاءِ الْقَوْمِ do not be faint‐hearted in pursuing the enemy.

entries.label: أَوْهَن
entries.definitionHtml:
أَوْهَن ʾawhan [elat.] weaker/weakest, more/most fragile or frail

(29:41) وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ الْعَنْكَبُوتِ but the frailest of [all] houses is the house of the spider.

entries.label: مُوهِنٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُوهِنٌ mūhin [act. part.] one that causes weakness

(8:18) وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ الْكَافِرِينَ and God will weaken the disbelievers’ designs.

entries.label: وَهْنٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
وَهْنٌ wahn [v. n.] weakness, feebleness

(31:14) حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَى وَهْنٍ his mother carried him, [with weakness upon weakness] weakening increasingly.
